answer.summary: API types check failed because the generated TypeScript types differ from the committed ones. The PR adds inject_execution_threshold_minutes and SettingsInjectExecutionUpdateInput to the API but the generated types were not regenerated and committed. Re-running will fail the same way until the developer runs yarn generate-types-from-api and commits the result.
